purpose: Teach: 色素/躍動/網膜/植林/海中/調剤/産卵/堆積

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、肌の色素細胞研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper was on melanocytes in skin cell research, wasn't it?
lines.style: Warm, encouraging tone. Confident pause before his name. A teacher checking understanding with genuine curiosity, not testing. Eyes engaged.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、舞踊家の躍動分析を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—actually, my paper focused on movement analysis in dancers.
lines.style: Slight hesitation at the start, then steady. A gentle correction, not defensive. He's used to this pattern. Quiet but clear on the subject.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、糖尿病性網膜症の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, I thought your paper covered diabetic retinopathy?
lines.style: Softer, almost musing. A gentle probe—she's testing if he's following, or perhaps if he remembers. Conversational, not interrogative.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、山林の植林計画史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—my paper was actually on forest replanting and its historical development.
lines.style: Patient correction, without apology. Matter-of-fact but not cold. He knows she's listening now, and his tone reflects that.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 海中ロボット技術を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Underwater robotics technology—that was your subject?
lines.style: Engaged but open-ended. Slight lift at the end, genuine question rather than assumption. She's actively listening now, drawn in.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、薬局の調剤過誤防止研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I actually wrote about preventing medication dispensing errors in pharmacies.
lines.style: Steady correction. A note of quiet persistence—he's keeping pace with her, not thrown off. Direct eye contact in his voice.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、ウミガメの産卵保護を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sea turtle nesting protection—that was in your research, wasn't it?
lines.style: Reflective, almost a step back. She's genuinely intrigued now by the pattern. Slower pace. A moment of real consideration in her voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、地層の堆積過程を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—my paper examined the depositional processes of geological strata.
lines.style: Quiet firmness. The final correction carries no strain, but understated resolve. He's still here, still answering, still honest.
